assets.title: Brimmed Veil Hat Display
assets.description: One original static empty beekeeping-hat visual prop with a genuinely hollow domed crown, a broad annular brim, two cloth bindings and a tapered open veil. The veil is one welded closed lattice surface: 32 thin vertical solid strips cross nine horizontal solid bands, with 256 genuine finite through-windows. Every opening has radial thickness and four geometric side walls; no transparent cards or opaque cylinder is used. The thicker lower hem has a finite annular underside at ground datum, connected through the lattice and upper binding to the brim and crown. Six editable closed meshes, three solid PBR materials, no textures, head, mannequin, person, bees, stand or surrounding scene. One complete assembly counts as one prop. Metres, Z up, ground-centre origin, front -Y. Fixed visual pose only. The coarse stylized holes do not establish bee or insect exclusion. No protection from stings, protective efficacy, wearer or head-size fit, ventilation, textile physics, real soft-mesh load capacity, stability, manufacture, occupational equipment or safety certification is claimed.
